What is assumed inside R

Each medium reports a different currency — viewers, visits, listeners, subscribers. Converting them into one quantity, people reaching a single item, needs the constants below. None is measured; each is a stated assumption, collected in psi/audience.py so it can be replaced one at a time.

No per-item signal provider is configured, so every item from an outlet currently carries that outlet's average reach — the ranking within an outlet is decided by salience and discursiveness alone. Setting PSI_YOUTUBE_API_KEY or an analytics endpoint turns this on.
RADIO_EPISODES_PER_WEEK5weekly cume divided across this many episodes
PODCAST_EPISODE_VIEW_RATE0.1share of subscribers watching a given episode
PODCAST_AUDIO_MULTIPLE1.0audio listeners per video viewer
NEWSLETTER_OPEN_RATE0.4share of subscribers opening an issue
DIGITAL_ITEMS_PER_MONTH800articles per month, to split monthly visits
TV_SEGMENT_SHARE1.0share of a programme's average audience reached by one segment
US_ADULTS262,000,000US Census Bureau resident population 18+, 2024 vintage (rounded)

Method

  1. R — the outlet's sourced third-party audience figure, converted to people reaching one item, divided by US adults. Absolute: no normalisation against a category leader, no platform weights.
  2. S — Gallup's Most Important Problem (2026-08), applied proportionally across every topic an item addresses.
  3. D — Logos, Ethos and Pathos, each 0–10, rubric score_v2. Ethos is the speaker's standing with their own audience, never their fairness: the instrument is descriptive and must register a demagogue and a statesman alike.
  4. Points — I × 1,000, the expected influence per thousand American adults.
  5. 124 outlets, 108 with a sourced audience figure, each carrying a source URL, a verbatim quote and a date.
  6. 632 items published 2026-08-21 – 2026-09-04. 40 are headline-and-summary only, from outlets that block article fetching: their topics are meaningful, their discursiveness is not comparable with full text.
  7. Known gaps: the corpus is concentrated in a few days rather than spread over a month, and skewed towards outlets permitting automated fetching. Untranscribed audio is still missing.
  8. Nothing is estimated silently. Unsourced reach stays null, and every modelling constant is printed above. Scoring spend to date: $8.39.
